stdout:
Issue #24 is a singleton group: insert-select conflict paths outlive their target-specific processing scopes. No duplicate was found.

Verdict: easy-call. Restore the existing target scope for conflict paths without changing the source query scope.

The change is limited to SemanticQueryBuilder.visitInsertStatement and BaseSqmToSqlAstConverter.visitInsertSelectStatement, with regression coverage in the existing query test harness. This is a two-way change: internal query processing only, with no new public API, schema, or persisted format.

Verified at upstream 24e81f56cf9a136ab2f65d9151752ebae7fbec2c: the HQL target registry is populated in stateFieldsProcessingState but popped before conflict parsing; SQL AST conflict processing occurs after the target processing state has been popped. Criteria inserts bypass the former defect and expose the latter independently. Insert-values already processes conflicts inside its valid target scope.

Reuse the existing isolated HQL target-fields state around conflict parsing after source parsing, with balanced try/finally. Do not register the target into the source registry or expose source aliases in the conflict clause. Move SQL AST conflict conversion into the existing target-processing try, before its finally; keep source conversion outside that scope. Extending the SQL state across source conversion would change QuerySpec/QueryGroup topLevel classification; re-pushing it after source conversion would alter lastPoppedProcessingState used by translate().

Use small scalar HQL and criteria insert-select regressions, including conflict target and update assignment, plus insert-values/no-path controls, bind values and alias isolation. Existing InsertConflictTests and InsertConflictWithCriteriaCopyTreeEnabledTests provide the harness. Preserve CTE availability by leaving HQL source parsing before conflict parsing. No runtime test has yet been run: genuine focused RED/GREEN, format checks and independent review are required before publication. Current Jira is New/unassigned/unresolved; no matching all-state competing PR or task branch was found.

Open verification: establish actual failure signatures and H2 execution behavior, preserve source query shape and criteria-copy behavior, then broaden only within this issue's scope.
